chunks.text: Life is a journey where the destination remains unknown. We move ahead with no real manual for success. And as we travel, we fall and we get up stronger, creating memories and nurturing experiences. And then in that one moment, we look back at ourselves and see how far we’ve come and we are filled with a certain indescribable feeling. We’re filled with Pride! And it’s in that moment we know we have arrived. We have made it. We are home!

chunks.text: Every house is made from similar material. Brick for some, stone for the others. But what separates a roof over ones’ head from a space that makes you feel you belong is what Glitz Homes is all about. Having set up in the heart of Thrissur, Kerala, India, Glitz Homes’ sole purpose is to create homes for the millennium. Today, they have some of the most beautiful projects underway transforming the concept of the home altogether. BUILDING HOUSES. CREATING LIFESTYLES.

chunks.text: Glitz Pride is a one-of-its-kind luxury boutique gated villa community that epitomizes architectural perfection. This green space has been painstakingly designed to create a lifestyle that is in perfect harmony with the earth. On the outside, it instantly separates you from the toils of the everyday with its calm and peaceful aura. And as you enter your abode, this aura radiates within, inviting the joy of outdoors, indoors with maximum ventilation from natural air and lighting. Added rugged features like brick walls and high ceilings only further enhance the rustic, natural design. WELCOME TO NATURE’S PET. OWNER’S PRIDE. HIGHEST SECURITY STANDARDS CLUB HOUSE CHILDREN PLAY AREA HEALTH CLUB SHUTTLE COURT WIDE GUEST PARKING AREA VEGETABLE GARDEN STATE-OF-THE-ART SURVEILLANCE SYSTEMS BOUTIQUE GATED VILLA COMMUNITY 3D rendering

chunks.text: Lijo. Reny. Architects is an artistic duo that has transformed the landscape of Kerala with its award-wining architectural designs. Their influence is visible all over the state and their contributions to the world of architecture is unparalleled. For this duo, experimentation and breaking out-of-the-box along with a very keen sense of nature and a deep respect for all it offers has led them to create designs not only in architecture but also in the field of art where their contemporary installations draw massive appeal. ART IS ALL AROUND US AND YET IT TAKES AN ARTIST TO BRING IT TO LIFE. And from the dust it arose. And it stood tall as the pride of the land and everyone looked at it and knew its magnificence would tell stories for eons to come. And that’s power an artist truly wields. To not just build a structure but to create one that exudes beauty and balance. It is this vast experience and influence that they bring to Glitz Pride. Having designed this project meticulously, their design acumen, artistic appeal and practical balance is visible in every brick and stone. Awards won by the studio include: ‘Monsoon Architecture Award’, ‘NDTV Design & Architecture Awards’, ‘All India Stone Architectural Awards’, ‘JK State Young Architect of the Year Award’ and several IIA State awards. INTRODUCING THE DESIGNERS BEHIND EVERY DETAIL. LIJO. RENY. ARCHITECTS 3D rendering

chunks.text: When you stand amongst the rawness of what the earth has to offer, you are mesmerized. You look with awe and great respect at the space around you. And just as mother nature fiercely protects her own, you will find solitude and refuge under her foliage. And you will be filled with pride to be one with the magnificence of nature at your doorstep. In what will be your home! WHEN YOU LOOK OUT YONDER, THE EARTH LOOKS BACK AT YOU AND IN THAT MOMENT, YOU KNOW YOU ARE ONE! ALL YEAR LUSH GREENERY • PICTURESQUE LANDSCAPING • VEGETABLE GARDEN • SIGNATURE STYLING WITH INDOOR PLANTS 3D rendering

chunks.text: GROUND FLOOR Area: 1410 sq.ft. FIRST FLOOR Area: 810 sq.ft. WHEN EVERY BRICK AND HINGE STAND PROUD YOU KNOW YOUR HOME IS SPECIAL BECAUSE EVERY DETAIL SHINES. Our stunning designs are ably supported by our impeccable attention to detail. You will find that it is the smallest things that separate the great from the mediocre and that is why we have left no brick unturned to give you a home that revels in the finest fittings imported specially from Germany for your kitchen and other rooms. And as you walk by the walls, the elegant pieces selected to adorn your home balance beautifully with practical and user-friendly accessories. Bathroom – Sanitary and Accessory Fittings All bathroom accessories are of the highest quality with the most stylish designs from TOTO , one of the world’s leading suppliers of bathroom products. Sanitary fittings include the GEBERIT concealed cistern. The bathroom also comes with a Glass Shower Enclosure with fittings by HANSGROHE, one of the world’s largest shower head, hand shower and faucet suppliers. Door Frames and Shutters Only the best and strongest wood is used throughout the house with teak wood used for all door frames and shutters. This includes the front, internal and bathroom doors as well as the doors for the ventilator and windows. The front sliding door is made from DOMAL ALUMINUM. Painting and Water Proofing An acrylic Putty with 2 coat emulsion finish will be applied on all Interior walls while a 2 coat emulsion will be applied on all external walls. Water proofing will also be done for the slope slabs and the sunken slabs for the toilets. Flooring The gorgeous sit-out kitchen cum living room will have a GRANITE LAPATRO while all the bedrooms will be laid out with KAJARIA 4X2. Brick Masonry The brick masonry will be based on semi wirecut bricks in cement mortar 1.6 for a superstructure that includes curing. 3D rendering 3D rendering
